pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: crates/table-verify/src/lib.rs:1 The crate checks signed deal proof bundles deterministically and nothing in it scores agent or model output. A search of crates/table-verify found no rubric, pass rate, trials, leaderboard or temperature; its only 'judge' is the deterministic authority::judge rule, and acceptance.rs only maps test names to acceptance IDs, which is test-harness territory.

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/approval/review/says.ts:1 These are pure view-model modules and React views that turn wallet facts into words and buttons, with no non-deterministic system under measurement. A search of windows/approval found no rubric, pass rate, trials, leaderboard or temperature; the single 'llm' substring hit is 'sellMode'.

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/mock/backend.ts:1 The mock serves fixture data and mirrors the shell's deterministic gates for UI tests. It names agent engines ('claude-code', 'codex-cli') only as fixture strings and never runs or scores them. A search of src/mock found no rubric, pass rate, trials, leaderboard or temperature, and its 'judge' hits are deterministic mandate and shield checks.

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.css:1 This context is CSS tokens, motion helpers and SVG brand geometry with no model output to evaluate. A search of src/design and src/shared found no rubric, pass rate, trials, leaderboard or temperature, nor any judge or llm term.

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: crates/table-app/src/lib.rs:1 table-app gates agent intents and runs the money pipeline by deterministic rules (ShieldGate::judge, the checklist), which is authorization rather than measuring agent quality. A search of crates/table-app found no rubric, pass rate, trials, leaderboard or temperature; the one 'eval' hit is a comment about table_shield::evaluate.
